title: CustomCooldowns
description: This plugin impliments custom cooldowns for set items in the config.yml file
body:
CustomCooldowns is a lightweight semi-unique minecraft plugin which allows you to set a cooldown to ANY item in the game

Go to **config.yml** and add in a item alongside if its enabled and the cooldown-time

# Example of cooldowns

    mace: # has to be lowercase
      enabled: false # true or false
      cooldown-time: 30 # in seconds
